followups.author: ugamesoft
followups.parentText:
ugamesoft
6m
Good question . Hot reload only runs what you’ve saved, so half-typed edits never go live.
If a save has an error:
- Nothing gets patched. The last good code keeps running.
- The error shows in Problems and the Console, and the file waits for a fix.
- Play mode won’t start until it’s fixed, so you never test code you think is live but isn’t.
- No domain reload, so scene state and unsaved edits in other files stay put.
Fix, save, and it patches in.
